DEL Shifts

Source: R/esports.R
del_shifts.Rd

Every shift of one match, one row per player shift.

Wraps GET https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/de.hokejovyzapis.cz/matches/{match_id}/shiftsSC.json of the DEL eSports bucket. Example: https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/de.hokejovyzapis.cz/matches/4444/shiftsSC.json. Seasons are END years (2027 = 2026/27); every request waits at least one second after the last one to the same host.

Usage

del_shifts(match_id, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

match_id

Match id (per-bucket match key space: match_id in del_schedule). Not the league website's game id.

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE); FALSE returns the raw decoded JSON body (a nested list).

Value

A tibble::tibble() with one row per row of the file (zero rows, carrying the documented columns, for an empty frame); the raw JSON list when return_parsed = FALSE. Columns:

col_nametypedescription
shift_idintegerShift id within the shift files.
start_timeintegerShift start, game second.
start_real_timecharacterShift start, local wall clock.
end_timeintegerShift end, game second.
end_real_timecharacterShift end, local wall clock.
player_idintegerPlayer id (player key space, per bucket, stable across games and seasons); joins to playerId in rosters, events, boxscores and leaderboards.
player_namecharacterPlayer full name.
team_idintegerTeam id (team key space, per bucket, stable across seasons); joins to league-matches home.id / guest.id and the {team_id} path param.
team_namecharacterTeam display name.
durationintegerShift length in seconds (end_time - start_time).

Errors

Signalled as classed conditions: fastRhockey_no_data when the bucket has no such key (S3 404 NoSuchKey: unknown season, competition, match or team) or the file holds no rows (an unplayed game, an empty shot shell); fastRhockey_asset_fetch for any other non-2xx answer (403 AccessDenied), a connection failure after retries, an empty or unreadable 200 body, an error envelope, a body of the wrong shape, or a body for another season or game; fastRhockey_bad_request for an HTTP 400/422 or an invalid argument. All three also inherit fastRhockey_error. Wrappers raise; they never warn and return an empty frame.

See also

DEL (the league site whose widgets read this public eSports bucket)

Other DEL eSports functions: del_faceoffs(), del_game_info(), del_goalie_box(), del_pbp(), del_player_box(), del_roster(), del_schedule(), del_shots(), del_standings(), del_team_player_stats(), del_top_scorers()
